description: The bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 values for different categories. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking" from left to right in a non-alphabetical order. The vertical axis is labeled with values ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays four bars, with "Ours" represented by an orange bar, and the other three categories represented by blue bars. The approximate values of the bars are: "Ours" at 0.34, "- critiquing" at 0.28, "- scoring" at 0.17, and "- ranking" at 0.23. The bars are not stacked or grouped, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The chart is not sorted in a specific order by value, but rather follows the order of the categories on the horizontal axis.
